issue_request: FHIR-19815 was Published/Persuasive and reported that the IG Publisher no longer worked from behind a network proxy when contacting tx.fhir.org, even when launched with Java proxy system properties or the IG Publisher -proxy flag.
initial_application: No FHIR core source commit mentioning FHIR-19815 was found. The linked 2018 Zulip thread shows the proxy behavior investigation and confirms that the proposed -proxy workaround still failed for the reporter, but the trail is about IG Publisher runtime behavior rather than a FHIR resource, conformance definition, or normative page.
additional_context: Current build-scoped core source has ImplementationGuide active in source/fhir.ini, and its introduction links to external IG Publisher documentation; it does not contain IG Publisher networking code or local proxy instructions to correct. The 2022 Jira comment from Grahame Grieve says remaining problems should be raised in https://github.com/HL7/fhir-ig-publisher/issues. Related Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not reveal a later core-spec decision requiring source changes.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation is an empty audit commit with status external-repo because any remaining fix belongs in the IG Publisher project or its documentation outside the HL7/fhir core checkout.
